content.text: In countries where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable, digital creators often find themselves unable to sell their products effectively. This is particularly the case for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions facing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-trap-most-creators-2|The Payment]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-working-today-3|payment]] processing barriers. Fortunately, COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to sell digital products seamlessly using cryptocurrency, bypassing the limitations imposed by traditional platforms. With our [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-selling-notion-templates-crypto-serious-3|COREMERCH guide to complete]] deployment solutions, you will own your entire digital commerce stack, from payment processing to automatic product delivery.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

When traditional payment platforms fail or impose restrictive fees, it hinders digital creators from reaching their audience effectively. By utilizing COREMERCH's sovereign stacks, you gain complete control over your digital commerce environment. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge hefty fees on every sale, our solution leverages NOWPayments with only a 0.5% fee. This significant difference saves money; for instance, with 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your COREMERCH stack, ensure you have a few essentials in place. You need to create accounts on GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting, and familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation. Additionally, set up a Supabase account or Google Sheets for order management. Finally, decide which cryptocurrencies you will accept and set up your NOWPayments account for processing. With these components ready, you're prepared to construct a robust digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments into your stack. This will facilitate automatic crypto payment processing, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. Next, configure your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and product delivery. Ensure that your products are stored securely on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, allowing for instant access once payment is confirmed. This automation ensures a smooth customer experience and hassle-free transactions.
Retain more revenue with only a 0.5% fee on transactions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is ready, it's time to go live. Publish your site using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that everything is functioning as expected. Promote your digital products to your audience through social media and other channels. When you receive your first order, the NOWPayments webhook will trigger automatically, delivering the product instantly. Monitor the transaction closely to understand the process and confirm that everything operates smoothly. This will give you confidence in your newly established digital commerce infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Start by analyzing customer feedback and sales data to identify which products are performing well. Consider expanding your product lineup to include more digital goods. You can also leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates, to enhance your store further. As your sales grow, maintain your infrastructure's performance by optimizing your backend processes and ensuring that your delivery system remains efficient.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
No platform dependency means complete control over your digital commerce.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook by deploying a COREMERCH stack that accepts cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments. This method ensures you have full control over transactions and product delivery without relying on traditional payment platforms.

Utilizing a sovereign commerce stack, such as those offered by COREMERCH, is the best way to avoid platform fees. With only a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments, you retain more revenue compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your digital store using COREMERCH's infrastructure. This allows you to process payments directly and maintain ownership over your products.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This broad range gives your customers flexibility in payment options and enhances your sales potential.
How do I ensure my transactions are secure?

To ensure transaction security, utilize NOWPayments for processing and follow best practices for securing your backend infrastructure. Regularly update your software and monitor transactions for any irregularities.
